title: Aetheria: Age of Oblivion
description: This is a Dark Fantasy RPG-style compilation with an emphasis on complex combat, exploration of dangerous dungeons, and magic.
body:
🌌 Aetheria: Age of Oblivion
Aetheria: Age of Oblivion is a massive reimagining of Minecraft, transforming familiar survival into an epic adventure. Explore forgotten lands, battle colossal bosses, and master magic in a world where every biome hides a secret and every battle demands skill.

✨ Key Features
⚔️ Revolutionary Combat: Powered by Better Combat, battles are now truly dynamic! Experience fluid animations, combo attacks, and unique strike patterns for every weapon type.
🌍 Vivid & Detailed World: New terrain generation using Tectonic and Terrablender creates breathtaking mountains and valleys.
🛡️ Expanded Arsenal: A massive selection of melee weapons from Simply Swords and various magical artifacts.
🏺 Epic Challenges: Face legendary bosses from Cataclysm within intricately designed structures.
⚙️ Perfect Optimization: Built on Embeddium, ModernFix, and FerriteCore, ensuring high FPS and stability even on mid-range PCs.
🍂 Dynamic Nature: The Serene Seasons system changes the world around you, affecting agriculture and atmosphere.

🛠️ Full Mod List
This modpack is meticulously tuned for balance and immersion. Here are the core modules included:

⚔️ Combat & Gear
Better Combat — A complete overhaul of fighting mechanics.
Simply Swords — Dozens of new weapon types (rapiers, claymores, katars).
Traveler's Backpack — Functional backpacks for long journeys.
Accessories & Curios — Extra slots for magical rings and amulets.

🏰 Exploration & Structures
Cataclysm — Hardcore bosses and massive dungeons.
Towns and Towers — Updated villages and outposts.
Explorify & Structory — Dozens of new atmospheric buildings across the world.
Lootr — Individual loot for every player in chests.

🌿 World & Atmosphere
Tectonic — Large-scale terrain generation overhaul.
Nature's Spirit — Expanded flora and fauna.
Serene Seasons — A full seasonal cycle.
Farmer's Delight — Advanced cooking and farming system.

🖥️ Interface & Quality of Life (QoL)
Xaero's World Map & Minimap — The best navigation system available.
Jade — Informative tooltips for blocks and mobs.
AppleSkin — Visualization of hunger and saturation.
Mouse Tweaks — Enhanced inventory management.

🚀 Technical (Optimization)
Embeddium — A modern rendering engine for high FPS.
ModernFix & FerriteCore — Engine bug fixes and memory optimization.
Lithostitched — Optimization for datapacks and world processing.

🎮 How to Start?
Install the Modrinth App.
Create a new profile and import the .mrpack file.
Allocate 4–6 GB of RAM for a smooth experience.
Dive into the world of Aetheria!
